notes: v455 — 🫙 Fresh prices, guaranteed. Your app asks our server store which day it last holds, then skips downloading anything already up to that day. If the server under-reported that date — as it had been doing for the US market — shares were marked up to date at an old close and quietly stopped refreshing. The app now checks that answer against the calendar and against its own newest bar, and anything that doesn't look genuinely current is downloaded fresh from the market feed instead. Every price you saw was a real close, just older than it should have been. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5) to update.
